svg.aria-label: Figure 2 — FlatRowStore 32-byte widest-first packed record layout for Player and parallel ReferenceDirectory
svg.text: FlatRowStore record for Player (32 B fixed record + 1 ref slot)
64-byte aligned FlatChunk (4,096 slots on Pinned Object Heap) · widest-first alignment
Volatile.Read on load · same row idx
Side spill map only if Status = 2
Every fixed-width column sits on a multiple of its own width; string/vector references sit in a parallel chunk array.
